input.title: KPC-2026-014: Hair Growth Serum Actives, 10 Lines (6-Month Forecast)
input.scope: This RFx covers all ten ingredients for the hair growth serum, RM-001 to RM-010, with 6-month net volumes and a first need-by date of 20 December 2026 ahead of the 4 January 2027 production start and 1 February 2027 launch. All five vendors on file (V01 to V05) are invited to quote for all ten lines and to complete the questionnaire. Quotes should cover the full net volume with staged deliveries within the stated maximum per delivery for each line. Given the urgent timeline, vendors should state in their reply any line or document they cannot provide by the response deadline.

line_notes.note: Propanediol (bio-based), >=99.5% purity, existing item. Net 6M need 1293 kg. Max per delivery 1093 kg. Ambient storage. Minimum 18 months remaining shelf life on receipt.
Glycerin (vegetable, IP grade), >=99.5% purity, existing item. Net 6M need 1562 kg. Max per delivery 1264 kg. Ambient storage. Minimum 18 months remaining shelf life on receipt.
Niacinamide (PC grade), >=99% purity, existing item. Net 6M need 472 kg. Max per delivery 390 kg. Ambient storage. Minimum 18 months remaining shelf life on receipt.
D-Panthenol, 98% active, existing item. Net 6M need 251 kg. Max per delivery 175 kg. Cool storage. Minimum 12 months remaining shelf life on receipt.
Caffeine anhydrous, >=98.5% purity, existing item. Net 6M need 125 kg. Max per delivery 86 kg. Ambient storage. Minimum 18 months remaining shelf life on receipt.
Phenoxyethanol + Ethylhexylglycerin blend, 90:10, existing item. Net 6M need 280 kg. Max per delivery 240 kg. Ambient storage. Minimum 12 months remaining shelf life on receipt.
Hydroxyethylcellulose, viscosity grade 4,000-6,000 cP (2%), existing item. Net 6M need 144 kg. Max per delivery 102 kg. Ambient storage. Minimum 18 months remaining shelf life on receipt.

Rosemary leaf extract, 20% rosmarinic acid. New item. Net 6M need 28 kg. Max per delivery 12 kg. Cool storage (below 25 C, to be confirmed). Minimum 12 months remaining shelf life on receipt. New vendor qualification required.

Copper Tripeptide-1 solution, 1,000 ppm peptide. New item. Net 6M need 140 kg. Max per delivery 56 kg. Cold storage (2-8 C, to be confirmed). Minimum 9 months remaining shelf life on receipt. New vendor qualification required.

Acetyl Tetrapeptide-3 solution, 500 ppm peptide. New item. Net 6M need 280 kg. Max per delivery 112 kg. Cold storage (2-8 C, to be confirmed). Minimum 9 months remaining shelf life on receipt. New vendor qualification required.

terms: On-time-in-full (OTIF) delivery performance is a scored criterion; late or short deliveries against the staged schedule are subject to defined remedies.
Defect and out-of-spec rate reported per batch; lots failing spec are rejected and replaced at vendor cost.
Cold chain (2-8 C, to be confirmed per product) maintained from dispatch to receipt for RM-009 and RM-010, with temperature logs supplied with each shipment.
Cool storage (below 25 C, to be confirmed) maintained for RM-004 and RM-008, with temperature records supplied.
Ambient-zone items (RM-001, RM-002, RM-003, RM-005, RM-006, RM-007) shipped with standard packaging and batch CoA.
Certificate of Analysis per batch stating assay or purity, peptide concentration (ppm) for RM-009 and RM-010, rosmarinic acid content (%) for RM-008, and microbial limits.
Shelf life stated at delivery; minimum remaining shelf life as per line notes.
All prices in INR, quoted per line with delivery schedule; inventory-holding or consignment options quoted to reduce working capital.
Vendor to confirm batch traceability back to raw material source and manufacturing site.
Vendors acting as traders must name the manufacturing site and provide the manufacturer's documents for each line.
Vendors must flag in their reply any line, document or questionnaire item they cannot meet within the one-day response window.
questionnaire_focus: Manufacturing site and whether vendor is manufacturer or trader for each line
Source, extraction method and standardisation for rosemary extract; evidence of rosmarinic acid assay
Peptide synthesis route, purity method (HPLC), and stability data supporting 9-month shelf life at cold storage
Cold chain capability for RM-009 and RM-010: packaging, shipping lanes, temperature monitoring and excursion handling
Historical OTIF and batch defect rates for comparable cosmetic actives
Ability to split 6-month volume into deliveries within stated maximum per delivery sizes for each line
Regulatory documents: REACH/INCI conformity, GMP or ISO certification, and CoA sample
Lead time and minimum order quantities for first need-by 20 December 2026
Pricing breakdown in INR per line and any consignment or inventory-holding option
